evals.prompt: In this Next.js App Router project, add a login-gated admin console with a left sidebar and a token management table. The upstream service is https://api.example.com and the token list endpoint should look like /api/token/?p=1&size=10. Login sets an HTTP Only session cookie. Keep components small and configurable.
evals.expected_output: Uses local Next docs/AGENTS guidance, creates a same-origin /api/[...path] Node proxy, does not require token response for login, implements sidebar/header/table/dialog components in separate files, and runs lint/build.

evals.prompt: This console page works but the whole thing is in one 800-line components/console/console-app.tsx file. Split it into clean modules without changing behavior.
evals.expected_output: Splits entry, shell, layout, feature, dialog, small controls, formatting helpers, and clipboard helpers into focused files while preserving imports and passing lint/build.

evals.prompt: The browser shows a CORS error after login because the API returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and also sets cookies. Make the frontend call /api/user/login directly and proxy it through Next to http://api.example.com/api/user/login.
evals.expected_output: Implements an App Router catch-all route under app/api/[...path]/route.ts, forwards query/body/headers, rewrites Set-Cookie Domain for same-origin storage, uses credentials same-origin, and avoids adding /api/proxy when not requested.

evals.prompt: In the token management page, update calls must match this curl: PUT http://api.example.com/api/token/ with JSON body containing id, name, remain_quota, expired_time, unlimited_quota, model_limits_enabled, model_limits, cross_group_retry, group, allow_ips. The browser must call /api/token without triggering a 308, carry HTTP Only cookies, forward new-api-user from the logged-in user id, and GET /api/token?p=1&size=10 must not be cached.
evals.expected_output: Uses browser path /api/token for PUT with id in body, normalizes upstream trailing slash inside the Node proxy, forwards Cookie and Set-Cookie, adds new-api-user from session.user.id, and sets no-store/no-cache headers for management GETs and proxy responses.
